units.title: Tangents to two diameter circles pass through an altitude midpoint
units.statement: In acute triangle ABC, let AD,BE,CF be altitudes and P=AD∩EF. The tangents at D to the circumcircles of ADC and ADB meet AB and AC at X and Y. Set D=(0,0), A=(0,h), B=(-u,0), C=(v,0), with h²>uv. The circles have equations x²+y²−vx−hy=0 and x²+y²+ux−hy=0, so their tangents at D yield X and Y at height huv/(h²+uv). Direct foot coordinates give P at height 2huv/(h²+uv). Thus XY crosses AD at the midpoint of DP.
steps: Place BC on the horizontal axis with altitude AD vertical
Derive tangent lines at D from the two circle equations
Intersect EF with AD and compare the two heights
